description: Paper 37: TEP-ARP — Localized Proper-Time Gradients and the Spatial Proximity of Discordant Pairs. Application of the Temporal Equivalence Principle to Halton Arp's discordant quasar-galaxy pairs. The intrinsic conformal factor A_int = (1+z_G)/(1+z_Q) isolates a distance-independent proper-time gradient; luminous bridges, foreground absorption systems, and Poisson chance-alignment statistics demonstrate spatial proximity.
